title: 第138章 修仙界最大的靠山第137章 老师
content_zh:
第一卷第138章修仙界最大的靠山
涟绥道人整整在岸边坐了三天。
将心情调整好之后，就返回了临仙洞，在陈椽锡与凌璇玑面前行了三拜大礼，算是见过了两位‘师叔’。
睡了三个多月的凌璇玑对此大为震惊，与涟绥道人交谈期间，一个劲地看向陈玄，像是要从他脸上看出花来。
参与了大半过程的陈椽锡还好些，很是淡定的以长辈的身份与涟绥道人交谈。
只是不知为何，陈玄总觉得陈椽锡看他的眼神有些奇怪，仔细回忆之后，却又想不到哪里会得罪这位高人。
毕竟，他在这两人眼中，跟个透明人区别不大。
此前的秘密，早就被一眼看穿。
真正见识到这二位的仙家手段之后，陈玄就明白为何两人对他的功法和陶罐不感兴趣。
陈椽锡手上光陈玄见过的法宝就有六件，其中两件是圣人炼制的后天极品灵宝打仙鞭、阴阳镯，还有一件是本命灵宝山河绘卷。
单拎出来哪个比他的乾坤罐差？
凌璇玑法宝数量上差一些，只有两件，但品质比陈椽锡的只高不低，一件是先前困住涟绥道人的那根绳子，后天极品灵宝捆仙索，另一件是上古时出了名的宝贝玄黄塔……
而且人道弟子稀少，圣人老爷又常年清修，因此圣人的法宝基本都是两个弟子换着用。
就那太极图，号称开天辟地以来最强法宝，加上两人的诸多极品灵宝，个顶个的强也就罢了，形貌也是一个比一个高级。
说白了，陈玄就是想拿乾坤罐贿赂这两位，人家都嫌他那破罐子长得磕碜……
涟绥道人在人道二把手、三把手面前磕了头，这就算是正式加入人道阵营。
说实话，陈玄在做这件事的时候，没觉得有什么，但现在回想起来，却是心中有些发虚。
涟绥道人所谓的师父葫芦仙，本质上就是陈玄。
现在她又以为葫芦仙与陈椽锡是同辈，管这两位圣人弟子叫师叔。
这不是让他陈玄占了两人的便宜？

尽管两位圣人弟子没说什么，但圣人老爷一直在天上看着呢，这要是怪罪下来，他这条小命还要不要了？
陈玄只能在心中默默祈祷。
他这都是为了人道出力，希望圣人老爷不要为难他这个筑基境人道小后辈……
涟绥道人与两位圣人弟子并未交谈多久。
陈椽锡吩咐坐下弟子给她在十方岛安排了住处，让她以后就在此安心修行，若人道有需要，也能随时给她安排任务。
待涟绥道人跟着十方岛炼气士离开后，两位圣人弟子的视线齐齐落在陈玄身上。
“真不知道你这小家伙脑袋里装的都是什么，这么损的招都能想出来。”
凌璇玑苦笑，“我怎么觉得让你来应对禅道，比师弟要更合适些。”
陈玄注意到一旁的陈椽锡脸有点黑。
赶忙朝凌璇玑稽首道：“前辈过誉了，这并非什么高明的手段，而且您也看到了，真正做起来相当费时费力，想来陈前辈应是早就想到了，只不过是嫌麻烦，加上有意考教弟子，给弟子一个将功补过的机会，才主动将功劳让给了弟子。”
陈椽锡面色缓和，投来赞赏的目光。
content_en:
Volume 1 Chapter 138 The biggest backer in the world of immortality
Taoist Liansui sat on the shore for three days.
After adjusting his mood, he returned to Linxian Cave and bowed three times in front of Chen Rongxi and Ling Xuanji. It was considered that he had met the two 'Uncle Masters'.
Ling Xuanji, who had slept for more than three months, was greatly shocked by this. During the conversation with Taoist Liansui, she kept looking at Chen Xuan, as if she wanted to see the flowers on his face.
Chen Rongxi, who participated in most of the process, was better. He talked to Taoist Liansui very calmly as an elder.
But for some reason, Chen Xuan always felt that the way Chen Rongxi looked at him was a little strange. After carefully recalling it, he couldn't think of anything that could offend this expert.
After all, in the eyes of these two people, he was not much different from a transparent person.
The previous secrets had long been seen through.
After truly seeing the immortal methods of these two men, Chen Xuan understood why they were not interested in his skills and clay pots.
There are six magic weapons that Chen Xuan has seen in Chen Rongxi's hand, two of which are the best acquired spiritual treasures refined by saints, the Immortal Whip and the Yin-Yang Bracelet, and one is the natal spiritual treasure mountain and river scroll.
Which one of them is worse than his Qiankun jar?
The number of Ling Xuanji's magical treasures is slightly inferior, there are only two, but the quality is only higher than that of Chen Rongxi. One is the rope that trapped Taoist Liansui before, the best acquired spiritual treasure binding fairy rope, and the other is the famous treasure Xuanhuang Pagoda in ancient times...
Moreover, there are very few humanistic disciples, and the sage has been cultivating all the year round, so the sage’s magic weapon is basically used interchangeably by two disciples.
As for the Tai Chi Diagram, it is said to be the most powerful magic weapon since the beginning of the world. In addition to the two people's many top-grade spiritual treasures, each one is just stronger than the other, and their appearance is also more advanced than the other.
To put it bluntly, Chen Xuan just wanted to bribe these two people with the Qiankun jar. They all thought that his broken jar looked ugly...
Taoist Liansui kowtowed in front of the second and third leaders of Humanity, which was regarded as officially joining the Humanity camp.
To be honest, Chen Xuan didn't feel anything wrong when he did this, but now that he thinks about it, he feels a little guilty.
The so-called Master Gourd Immortal by Taoist Liansui is essentially Chen Xuan.
Now she thought that Gourd Immortal and Chen Rongxi were peers, and called these two disciples of the saint uncle.
Doesn't this allow him, Chen Xuan, to take advantage of the two of them?
Although the two saint disciples didn't say anything, the saint master has been watching from the sky. If he is blamed for this, will he still have this little life?
Chen Xuan could only pray silently in his heart.
He is doing his best for humanity. He hopes that the saint will not embarrass him, a junior at the Foundation Establishment Realm...
Taoist Liansui did not talk to the two saint disciples for long.
Chen Rongxi asked his disciples to arrange a residence for her on Shifang Island, so that she could practice here with peace of mind. If humanity needs it, they can arrange tasks for her at any time.
After Taoist Liansui left with the Qi Master from Shifang Island, the eyes of the two saint disciples fell on Chen Xuan.
"I really don't know what's going on in your little guy's head. You can think of such damaging moves."
Ling Xuanji smiled bitterly, "Why do I think it's more appropriate for you to deal with Zen Dao than my junior brother?"
Chen Xuan noticed that Chen Rongxi's face was a little dark.
He hurriedly bowed to Ling Xuanji and said: "Senior, you are overly praised. This is not a clever method. And you can see that it is quite time-consuming and laborious to actually do it. I think Senior Chen must have thought of it a long time ago. He just felt it was troublesome and wanted to test the disciples and give them a chance to make up for their mistakes, so he took the initiative to give the credit to the disciples."
Chen Rongxi's expression softened and he cast an appreciative glance.
